note: Two-note phrase used by the legacy projects. The first note starts at 0.10 s and decays; the second re-attacks hard at sample 37485 (0.85 s) - that is the project time marker. Old projects seek to sample 36603 (0.83 s), 20 ms before the marker, i.e. inside the still-sounding tail of the first note. The first analysis window of that cold slice is zero-padded on the left, so the re-attack is reconstructed slightly early; the same window rendered with real pre-roll lands on the marker.
